capabilities: Surface semantically related notes for the current note in a Connections view
Run semantic Lookup searches across the vault by meaning
Drag results into notes to create links
Pin or hide individual connection results
Copy connections as a list of links or as AI-ready context text
disambiguation: Not a backlinks tool; it finds notes that are semantically similar in meaning, not notes that literally link to the current one.
extras: Free core is zero-setup with a local embedding model and no API key; advanced features (inline/footer connections, reranking, Bases integration) require paid Connections Pro. Smart Chat was split into a separate plugin. Users of third-party sync tools should add the .smart-env/ directory to sync ignore patterns. README is heavily padded with testimonials.
motivation: The author built it as a personal tool to solve his own organization problems, after losing track of important ideas in his own notes.
problem: In large vaults, valuable notes get buried because nothing links them, forcing users to scroll, reread, and redo work instead of writing.

relations.evidence: Connections Pro builds on the core plugin and Smart Environment to give power users more control

summary: Semantic related-note finder that uses a local embedding model to surface notes similar to the current note, with a Connections view and on-demand Lookup search.
